events.title: Camilla PNK
description: Camilla PNK is a guitarist and DJ/producer who plays live guitar over her own DJ sets. I got to photograph her show thanks to JNIGHT, and it pushed me towards a looser, more experimental style, with motion blur and light trails, that I'd like to explore further.
